decisions.reason: The pinned lexer reserves block continuation and closing keywords; prevent a competing identifier statement from retaining a rejected keyword interpretation as an ambiguity.

cases.title: pattern matching
cases.source:
case expr
  in 5 then true
  else false
end

case expr
  in x unless x < 0
  then true
  in x if x < 0
  then true
  else false
end

case expr
  in 5
  in 5,
  in 1, 2
  in 1, 2,
  in 1, 2, 3
  in 1, 2, 3,
  in 1, 2, 3, *
  in 1, *x, 3
  in *
  in *, 3, 4
  in *, 3, *
  in *a, 3, *b
  in a:
  in a: 5
  in a: 5,
  in a: 5, b:, **
  in a: 5, b:, **map
  in a: 5, b:, **nil
  in **nil
  in [5]
  in [5,]
  in [1, 2]
  in [1, 2,]
  in [1, 2, 3]
  in [1, 2, 3,]
  in [1, 2, 3, *]
  in [1, *x, 3]
  in [*]
  in [*, 3, 4]
  in [*, 3, *]
  in [*a, 3, *b]
  in {a:}
  in {a: 5}
  in {a: 5,}
  in {a: 5, b:, **}
  in {a: 5, b:, **map}
  in {a: 5, b:, **nil}
  in {**nil}
  in {}
  in []
end

cases.title: more pattern matching
cases.source:
case expr
  in 5
  in ^foo
  in ^$foo
  in ^@foo
  in ^@@foo
  in ^(1+1)
  in ^(foo)
  in ^(Foo::Bar)
  in var
  in "string"
  in %w(foo bar)
  in %i(foo bar)
  in /.*abc[0-9]/
  in 5 .. 10
  in .. 10
  in 5 ..
  in 5 => x
  in 5 | ^foo | var | "string"
  in Foo
  in Foo::Bar
  in ::Foo::Bar
  in (nil | self | true | false | __LINE__ | __FILE__ | __ENCODING__)
  in -> x { x == 10 }
  in :foo
  in :"foo bar"
  in -5 | +10
end
